name: Tinkmaster Overspark
summary: In Stormwind, Brother Sarno hears that Techbot has failed and that Tinkmaster Overspark grieves in Ironforge. He sends Alliance adventurers to Tinker Town, where Overspark asks for help recovering Techbot's memory core from Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Plea from the Cathedral
sections.body: Brother Sarno tends to travelers in Stormwind City and speaks of trouble among the gnomish refugees. Tinkmaster Overspark, one of the minds behind Gnomeregan's wonders, grieves over Techbot's corruption. The mechanical servant once aided the tinkerers faithfully. Then the city fell into ruin.

sections.title: To Tinker Town
sections.body: You take the Deeprun Tram from Stormwind to Ironforge's Tinker Town. There, Overspark seeks adventurers willing to help in Gnomeregan's irradiated halls. He asks them to salvage what remains of Techbot's faculties before the construct causes irreparable harm.

faq.answer: Tinkmaster Overspark is a gnome engineer who trains gnomish engineering. He is in Tinker Town in Ironforge, coordinating efforts to reclaim Gnomeregan and rescue stray gnomish technology from the ruined capital.

aliases: where to get tinkmaster overspark quest
faq.answer: Brother Sarno, a human cleric in Stormwind City, sends you to help the gnomes in Ironforge.
Techbot is a mechanical creation designed by Tinkmaster Overspark. It once served gnomish engineers as a helpful tool, but malfunctioned after Gnomeregan fell and went rogue in the irradiated city.

faq.q: Where can Tinkmaster Overspark be found?
faq.answer: Tinkmaster Overspark is in Tinker Town, the gnomish quarter in Ironforge's eastern district, among fellow refugee tinkerers and experimental machinery.

faq.q: What follows after speaking to Overspark?
faq.answer: After you speak with Overspark, he asks you to enter Gnomeregan, deactivate Techbot, and retrieve its memory core so it can be restored.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance interested in an inventor's broken machine?
faq.answer: The Alliance cares about the exiled gnomes, and rogue automatons in Gnomeregan threaten expeditions trying to reclaim the underground capital or guard Dun Morogh's borders.

angles.text: As a gnome, each creation you salvage and memory core you recover preserves a piece of your fallen homeland from radiation and troggs.
As an engineer, you can learn from the cutting edge of gnomish ingenuity by examining Overspark's rogue creations.
As a member of the Alliance, helping the displaced gnomes in Tinker Town strengthens the bonds between Stormwind and the dwarven and gnomish kingdoms.
